name: Congenital Aneurysm of the Interatrial Septum

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Echocardiographic Criteria for Interatrial Septal Aneurysm

criteria.description: Localized bulging of the interatrial septum >10 mm beyond the plane of the atrial septum
Visualization of aneurysmal interatrial septum by transthoracic or transesophageal echocardiography
History of embolic events without other identifiable source

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of localized bulging >10 mm on echocardiography with confirmation of aneurysmal interatrial septum
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily imaging-based; clinical correlation with embolic events supports diagnosis.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Interatrial septal bulging detected on echocardiography

pathognomonic.notes: May present as transient ischemic attack or stroke

laboratory: No specific laboratory abnormalities; coagulation profile may be evaluated if embolism suspected
imaging: Echocardiography showing localized bulging of interatrial septum >10 mm
Transesophageal echocardiography for detailed septal assessment
Cardiac MRI may be used for further anatomical delineation
genetic: No known specific genetic mutations identified
other: History of embolic events without other identifiable source
Possible association with patent foramen ovale

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of persistent foramen ovale with right-to-left shunting
Absence of localized aneurysmal bulging of interatrial septum
Defect or hole in interatrial septum rather than aneurysmal bulging

redFlags: Sudden onset neurological deficits suggestive of embolic stroke
Evidence of systemic embolism without other source
references: Hanley PC, Tajik AJ, Hynes JK, et al. Diagnosis and classification of atrial septal aneurysm by two-dimensional echocardiography: report of 80 consecutive cases. J Am Coll Cardiol. 1985;6(6):1370-1382.
Pearce LA, McClure LA, Anderson DC, et al. Interatrial septal aneurysm and risk of ischemic stroke in the SPARC study. Stroke. 2000;31(7):1526-1530.
Khandheria BK, Tajik AJ, Edwards WD, et al. Interatrial septal aneurysm: a review. Mayo Clin Proc. 1995;70(1):35-43.
